name: Empowered Blood (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-21: In Pursuit of Water
description: Glowing red Daemonic runes blaze when blood falls on them.
disable: DC 20 Thievery (untrained) to scratch out enough runes to disrupt the magic or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the runes
reset: The hazard resets at the beginning of each round until it is disabled.

generalAbilities.name: Siphon Blood
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature is reduced to 0 HP in the magic circle

Effect Sezruth (the aghash div in area C) gains 1 Blood Point.
